scope: Read-only production Worker settings, deployment allocation, D1 schema and aggregate metadata; no account content or credentials.

worker.commit_sha_note: Cloudflare version metadata exposes no source commit SHA; deployed source compatibility is not established by these observations.

database.name: patternlike-ops
aggregate_limitations: Accepted-document count checks active accounts, user-confirmed locale, matching accepted claim/document fingerprint hashes, an active chart/profile, and no recalled document ontology. It does not hash each current chart fingerprint or project encrypted documents.
Consent counts describe latest status, grant timestamp, and expiry only. They do not prove complete policy/permission validity or consent association with a particular accepted document.
currentPattern requires exactly four projected chapters; that runtime predicate was not evaluated because account content was excluded.
Absent portrait tables imply no stored image/mesh rows in those tables; row counts are not reported as zero for nonexistent tables.

ontology.origin_evidence: docs/deploy/openai-pattern-rollout.md superseding decision (2026-08-27), referring to the same active version. Signed R2 release bytes were not fetched or reverified.
ontology.source_gate: apps/api/src/db/pattern-ontology.ts ontologyServesAccount: synthetic_internal is admitted; machine_pipeline requires public activation scope.
ontology.assessment: Zero pipeline evidence does not block the documented authored release under current source policy. No new ontology release or public machine-pipeline activation is required solely for portrait enablement.
ontology.runtime_verification: Not invoked against an authenticated account; live release signature/content verification and currentPattern eligibility remain outside this read-only aggregate check.

activation_prerequisites: Complete final repository merge gate on frozen intended source.
Back up production D1 and apply additive migrations 0026 then 0027 before enabling compatible API features.
Deploy and verify the compatible API/frontend revision; observed version metadata alone does not identify its source commit.
Deploy the standalone codex-runner artifact and production dependencies; verify pinned Codex CLI 0.153.3, existing ChatGPT authentication and content-free preflight on the runner host.
Enable API PATTERN_PORTRAIT_ENABLED=1 and PATTERN_PORTRAIT_MESH_ENABLED=1 with runner CODEX_RUNNER_PORTRAITS=1 and CODEX_RUNNER_MESHES=1 only after compatible schema and code are live.
Use an explicitly authorized automation grant and verify image-to-mesh completion, authenticated retrieval, source identity, and the full Reading view on a current four-chapter account Pattern.
